name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Operations | Onboarding, Implementation & Customer Support | High-Volume Follow-Through, AI-Forward
summary: Customer operations and onboarding specialist with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, built around responsiveness and follow-through at volume. Managed ~25 concurrent onboardings at Wix while launching 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets, handled 50+ partner activities a day at Birdeye while retaining all but one partner (~94%), and today owns implementation and day-to-day support for every Solenzo client. Tracks every open item, troubleshoots through resolution, and builds the automated updates and repeatable workflows that keep customers from ever wondering about status. Uses Claude and ChatGPT daily to work faster, and builds AI into production workflows.

experience.title: Client Onboarding & Operations (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Own onboarding, implementation, and ongoing support for every client, from discovery through configuration, training, and day-to-day questions.
Troubleshoot integration and workflow issues myself, reading webhook and API payloads to find where a handoff broke and fixing it through resolution.
Built automated confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups by email and SMS so customers get proactive status updates without having to ask.
Track every interaction, commitment, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping records accurate across concurrent engagements.
Use Claude and ChatGPT daily to draft, debug, and document faster, and call LLM APIs inside production workflows.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Resolved client feedback promptly across multi-stakeholder accounts, coordinating across internal departments to keep delivery quality consistent and protect retention.

bullets: Handled 50+ partner activities per day across onboarding and partner communication, guiding customers through technical setup and configuration.

Built scalable communication workflows and automated training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Brought recurring customer issues to Product and Engineering as structured, prioritized feedback.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors, managing tasks in ClickUp and Monday.com; served a banking-industry client.
